reset.description: Reset all settings options to default options (refresh page after reset)
reset.title: Reset settings options

bindings.description: One binding per line: the group_openid of a group and the ID of an inbox document, separated by a space. Each message of the group is first inserted into the .temp document under the inbox document, then moved to the end of the YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD document under it. Missing documents are created automatically. The group_openid can be found in the event log
bindings.title: Bound groups

downloadAssets.description: When a message contains images, voice, videos or files, download them into the workspace with the SiYuan feature that converts network assets to local ones before moving the message
downloadAssets.title: Download assets

appid.description: AppID of the QQ bot, available in the development settings of the bot on the QQ Open Platform (q.qq.com)
appid.title: AppID QQ_BOT_APPID

device.description: When on, only this device connects to the QQ bot and writes the event log and the inbox; other devices disconnect from the gateway once the config syncs to them. When off, every device connects, and writing the inbox on several devices may create duplicate messages or sync conflicts
device.title: Run on this device only
device.unassigned: No device is set, every device connects

eventLog.description: Save every event pushed by the gateway as unindented JSON to data/storage/petal/im-bot/logs/events/<event type>/<event ID>.json of the workspace, synced with your data. Events without an event ID (READY, RESUMED) are not saved
eventLog.title: Event log

intents.description: The gateway only pushes events of the subscribed categories. Received events are written to the kernel log, and the bot reconnects after a change. Categories other than guilds, guild members and guild @bot messages may need permission from the QQ Open Platform first; the gateway closes the connection (4014) when a subscribed category is not permitted. See Event Subscription and Notification for the events in each category
intents.title: Subscribed events QQ_BOT_INTENTS

secret.description: AppSecret of the QQ bot, used to get the access token. It is stored in plain text in data/storage/petal/im-bot/config.json of the workspace and synced with your data
secret.title: AppSecret QQ_BOT_SECRET
